canada.summary: A pilot has died in a plane crash linked to a Remembrance Day ceremony in Quebec's Beauce region Wednesday morning.

canada.summary: Mayor says budget will focus on service delivery, priority projects amid challenging financial environment

canada.title: Police genealogy team IDs British man who died in Toronto 34 years ago
canada.summary: Months of work by Toronto police's genealogy team and investigators have unmasked a man who died in the city's downtown in 1992.

canada.title: 'Poignant' Halifax Remembrance Day ceremony comes soon after Wainwright tragedy
canada.summary: A large crowd gathered at Grand Parade in Halifax on Wednesday morning to mark Remembrance Day, less than a month after a tragedy at CFB Wainwright in Alberta saw four service members killed.

canada.title: Looming loss of only brick-and-mortar bank in Saint-Chrysostome, Que., has seniors worried
canada.summary: The Caisse Desjardins branch in Saint-Chrysostome is set to close on Jan. 25, 2027. The company cites changing banking habits and declining traffic. Locals, especially seniors, are worried about losing an essential service.

canada.title: The remarkable story behind the secret Canadian guerrilla force you've never heard of
canada.summary: It's 1944. Britain's secretive Special Operations Executive decides it wants to build a covert force to send into Japanese-occupied Asia. Needing soldiers who can blend in — with language skills — they ask Chinese Canadians. Despite being originally barred due to racism, about 150 said yes.

canada.title: Sleeping driver in self-driving vehicle woken up, stopped and charged in Ottawa
canada.summary: Provincial police in Ottawa said they stopped and charged a sleeping driver in a self-driving vehicle on Highway 417 during rush hour Tuesday.

canada.title: Atlantic Canadian padres honour Wainwright soldiers in Remembrance Day speeches
canada.summary: Two padres in Atlantic Canada led their Remembrance Day speeches on Wednesday with reflections on the recent deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, in Alberta.

canada.title: Calgary shelters support more than 2,000 people fleeing violence, report finds
canada.summary: A new report says getting survivors out of dangerous situations is only the first step, with affordable housing, ongoing support and prevention programs also needed to help break the cycle of domestic violence.

canada.title: Wapiti Regional Library closing 6 rural branches in north-central Sask.
canada.summary: The six library branches slated for closure in December are in Alvena, Gronlid, Mistatim, Pilger, Prairie River and St. Benedict.

canada.title: Flood warnings issued for parts of southern B.C., as storm batters province
canada.summary: B.C. Hydro is warning that some drenched areas of the province could be without power for days, as a fall storm continued to make its presence felt on Wednesday. The River Forecast Centre has upgraded some areas on the South Coast as well as Pemberton Valley to flood warnings.

canada.title: Environmental group sends legal warning to pension funds over potential LNG investments
canada.summary: Environmental advocacy group Stand.earth has enlisted a high-profile law firm to warn six major pension funds against investing in liquefied natural gas megaprojects, saying climate-related and other risks could expose plan administrators to legal action.

canada.title: People gather in Winnipeg for Manitoba's largest Remembrance Day ceremony
canada.summary: People gathered in Winnipeg on Wednesday for a Remembrance Day ceremony at the RBC Convention Centre. The annual service, hosted by the Joint Veterans Association, typically draws thousands of attendees.

canada.title: Parks Canada to shut down 3 northern warden detachments, centralize in Yellowknife
canada.summary: Kluane National Park and Reserve in Yukon, Nahanni National Park Reserve in N.W.T., and Wood Buffalo National Park in N.W.T. and Alberta will lose their detachments.

canada.title: Sask. WW II vet says laughter helped him live to 100
canada.summary: One of increasingly few surviving Second World War veterans, John Watson still attends all the Remembrance Day ceremonies in Swift Current, Sask. He also recently returned to the Netherlands to mark the anniversary of its liberation.

canada.title: City takes Fredericton Exhibition settlement dispute to court
canada.summary: Fredericton council voted Monday night to take the expropriation process for the Exhibition Grounds to court as both sides have been unable to reach a payment deal.

canada.title: What's open, closed around Halifax for Remembrance Day
canada.summary: Under Nova Scotia's Remembrance Day Act, some retail businesses must be closed Nov. 11, including malls, big-box stores and grocery stores.

canada.title: Ukrainian war veteran from Manitoba's Interlake walks the walk in fundraising campaign
canada.summary: Ukrainian war veteran Peter Derksen has completed a nearly six-month and over 4,000 kilometre hike on the Pacific Crest Trail, travelling on foot from the U.S.-Mexico border to Canada as part of a personal fundraising campaign for the ongoing war effort.
